requirements.quote:
The TLS EndOfEarlyData message is not used with QUIC.  QUIC does not
   rely on this message to mark the end of 0-RTT data or to signal the
   change to Handshake keys.
requirements.condition: When QUIC determines that the peer has finished sending 0-RTT data.
requirements.required_behavior: Determine the end of 0-RTT without an EndOfEarlyData message.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not wait for or rely on EndOfEarlyData to mark the end of 0-RTT data.
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake trace with 0-RTT but no EndOfEarlyData can verify that QUIC still transitions beyond the 0-RTT sending period.

requirements.quote:
The TLS EndOfEarlyData message is not used with QUIC.  QUIC does not
   rely on this message to mark the end of 0-RTT data or to signal the
   change to Handshake keys.
requirements.condition: When QUIC changes from early-data keys to Handshake keys.
requirements.required_behavior: Perform the key-level transition without an EndOfEarlyData signal.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not wait for or rely on EndOfEarlyData to signal use of Handshake keys.
requirements.why_checkable: A normal QUIC handshake omitting EndOfEarlyData can be observed for timely installation and use of Handshake keys.

requirements.quote: Clients MUST NOT send the EndOfEarlyData message.
requirements.condition: During any TLS handshake carried by a QUIC client.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send an EndOfEarlyData message.
requirements.why_checkable: Decrypted client CRYPTO streams can be parsed for TLS handshake message types and checked for absence of EndOfEarlyData.

requirements.quote:
A server MUST
   treat receipt of a CRYPTO frame in a 0-RTT packet as a connection
   error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.condition: When a server receives a CRYPTO frame in a 0-RTT packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the frame placement as PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not accept or process the CRYPTO frame as valid 0-RTT content.
requirements.error_behavior: Close the connection with error type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.why_checkable: A crafted 0-RTT packet containing CRYPTO can be sent and the server's connection-close error type observed.

requirements.quote:
As a result, EndOfEarlyData does not appear in the TLS handshake
   transcript.
requirements.condition: When constructing or verifying the TLS handshake transcript for QUIC.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not insert a synthetic or received EndOfEarlyData message into the transcript hash.
requirements.why_checkable: Transcript instrumentation or Finished verification vectors can reveal whether EndOfEarlyData bytes were included in the transcript hash.
